_doc: Single source of truth for processed/splits.parquet. Edit, then run: python scripts/10_splits.py
_sparse_doc: A round is 'sparse' (not eval-eligible) when fewer than this % of the 2,759 wells have a reading in it. Main rounds (2000-2022) use sparse_round_min_coverage_pct; extension rounds (2023-2024) use ext_sparse_round_min_coverage_pct, because extension coverage is low by construction (30.9% overall) and a 70% rule would exclude every extension round.
